dataset.name: A multi-modal sensor dataset for continuous stress detection of nurses in a hospital
dataset.version: Dryad files published 2021-09-17; pinned dataset DOI, no newer version asserted

download_source.identity_check: Zenodo mirror file MD5 matches the file checksum displayed on the Dryad record

purpose: External SSL-only transfer of frozen WESAD-trained fault-rejection scores to naturalistic E4 work-shift signals with deterministic synthetic perturbations; no stress/task prediction.

frozen_models.ssl: All nine WESAD-only compact native PhysioME-inspired v7 fold/seed checkpoints and both fixed scores: physiome_raw_1nn and physiome_restoration
frozen_models.primary_comparator: The nine previously selected WESAD-only derivative_roughness_hybrid fold/seed artifacts
frozen_models.thresholds: Existing WESAD-only calibration ranks and frozen assignment rules; no tuning on nurse data

units.acc: Source documentation reports m/s^2; convert to WESAD raw 1/64-g counts as (m/s^2) * 64 / 9.80665

signal_preprocessing.rate_conversion: Read source rate and timestamps from signal files only; deterministic scipy.signal.resample_poly, Kaiser beta 5, rational ratio limited to denominator 10000. If TEMP is 1 Hz, upsample deterministically to 4 Hz; this does not add measured bandwidth and must be disclosed. Stop before outcomes if source metadata cannot support this fixed conversion.
signal_preprocessing.alignment: Within each recording, use timestamp overlap of the four E4 channels only; no extrapolation, gap filling, or interpolation across gaps. Drop incomplete 10-second windows only.
signal_preprocessing.window_sampling: Select one 10-second window from each consecutive 10-minute eligible recording block. Select the within-block 10-second slot deterministically from SHA256(participant pseudonym, recording ordinal, block ordinal, protocol seed 20261017); no labels or signal values influence selection. Keep all eligible sampled windows.
signal_preprocessing.eligibility: A recording is signal-eligible only when all four signal files are nonempty, finite over candidate windows, have positive timestamps and no interval greater than 1.5 times their within-file median interval. Report every excluded recording and reason. Include participants with at least 100 eligible sampled windows; report all counts. Require at least 10 eligible participants before scoring or stop as technically underpowered/ineligible.
signal_preprocessing.normalization: Use only each frozen model's WESAD training-fold moments; estimate no nurse-cohort moments.

analysis.faults: Apply frozen structured_faults_v3: drift, source-relative range clipping, sample hold, and mean-imputed gap, each at low/medium/high levels. All four single-modality targets are primary; six pair targets, no-ops, and clean windows are descriptive/secondary.
analysis.randomization: Use deterministic source/window/family/modality fault seed rule from structured_faults_v3, extended by stable recording ordinal; record exact extension and verify repeatability before outcome scoring.
analysis.primary_endpoint: Participant-equal, equal-modality standardized fault-excess MSE among retained sampled nonzero-dose single-fault windows at each frozen WESAD threshold. Average recording then model fold/seed results within participant before inference.
analysis.coverage_guard: For each SSL score, the participant-bootstrap one-sided 95% lower confidence bound for paired coverage difference versus hybrid must exceed -0.05 (five percentage points). Report unmodified-window alert rates and all modality/fault coverage.
analysis.zero_coverage_rule: If any participant has zero retained windows in any required modality for an SSL score, that score's primary selective-risk contrast is NOT ESTIMABLE and automatically fails the joint success rule. Do not impute risk, remove the participant, or compute a confirmatory selective-risk p-value for that score.
analysis.inference: Participant is the inference unit. Paired participant bootstrap (10000 replicates, seed 20261017), percentile 95% intervals; paired two-sided sign-flip test (100000 flips, seed 20261018) for the two risk contrasts with Holm correction. Coverage guard uses paired participant bootstrap with a one-sided 95% lower bound. No window-level inferential tests.
analysis.success_rule: At least one frozen SSL score must have an estimable selective-risk contrast, lower risk than the hybrid with Holm-adjusted two-sided p < 0.05, and pass the 5-point coverage noninferiority guard. Otherwise report failure without selecting a threshold or score post hoc.
secondary: risk/coverage by modality and fault family/level
eligible natural recording duration and exclusions
limits: Injected faults do not establish natural artifact detection or natural signal quality
One hospital system and 15 female nurses limit transportability
Repeated windows/recordings are clustered within 15 participants
No stress, emotion, clinical, or occupational outcome claim

preflight_gates: Before reading any signal values, verify the dataset archive inventory and exclude SurveyResults.xlsx, tags.csv, HR.csv, IBI.csv, and all other annotations from extraction and parsing.
Verify file metadata, actual rates, units, timestamp alignment, nonempty recording counts, coverage, and deterministic conversion on signal files only.
If units/rates or alignment cannot meet the frozen conversion without additional assumptions, stop and report technical ineligibility before model outcomes.
Do not screen recordings using stress/task labels, model outputs, or outcomes.
amendment_before_signal_access: A publicly accessible Zenodo mirror of the exact Dryad signal ZIP was verified by matching its published MD5. This specifies transport only; analysis, inputs, and stop conditions are unchanged.
